fields.notes: CoreSight IS, in effect, a chip's in-system debug/trace DFT infrastructure layered over the JTAG/SWD boundary-scan transport. The JTAG TAP itself still provides classic boundary scan / IDCODE / scan-test access; CoreSight adds memory-mapped register access, real-time trace, and cross-triggering on top. Conformance is to ARM's (proprietary) CoreSight architecture.
fields.ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture
fields.dft_architecture_summary: ADIv5 SWD is fundamentally a DEBUG-access architecture, not a DFT (manufacturing test) architecture in the IEEE 1149.1 sense. SWD does not implement boundary-scan cells on every external I/O pin; it does not enable EXTEST/INTEST/RUNBIST. The 'DFT' SWD provides is in-system controllability and observability of the CPU + system bus via the MEM-AP.

debug_access_architecture_topology.description: Host → SW-DP → DP register set → AP bus (up to 256 APs) → MEM-AP (CSW+TAR+DRW) → SoC system bus → memory-mapped resources.
key_components_reached: Cortex-M Debug Control Block: DHCSR, DCRSR, DCRDR, DEMCR.
Flash Patch & Breakpoint Unit (FPB) — hardware breakpoint comparators.
Data Watchpoint & Trace Unit (DWT) — hardware watchpoint comparators + PC sampling.
Instrumentation Trace Macrocell (ITM) — printf-style trace → SWO.
Embedded Trace Macrocell (ETM) — full instruction-data trace → TPIU.
Trace Port Interface Unit (TPIU) — funnels trace to SWO or parallel trace pins.

fields.internal_scan_optional: Beyond ADIv5 SWD, SoCs typically implement traditional internal scan chains accessed via the SWJ-DP's JTAG mode. These are vendor-specific and orthogonal to SWD.
fields.bist_optional: RUNBIST is a JTAG instruction NOT an SWD feature. SoCs that implement BIST typically initiate it via vendor-specific MEM-AP-reachable BIST control registers OR via the SWJ-DP's JTAG mode.
applications_documented_in_adiv5: Multi-core SoC debug coordination via CTI.
ITM / DWT trace capture via SWO.
ETM trace capture via TPIU trace pins.
Boot ROM / secure boot enrolment via vendor-specific MEM-AP registers.
test_methodologies: CoreSight Trace Capture via SWO or TRACEDATA pins.
BIST initiation via vendor MEM-AP registers.
Internal Scan Test orthogonal to ADIv5.
design_for_test_flow_relationship_to_adi: ADIv5 SWD is layered ABOVE the SoC's classical DFT.
SoCs typically expose both ADIv5 SWD (for debug) AND IEEE 1149.1 JTAG (for boundary-scan + scan-test) via SWJ-DP.
Production test typically: JTAG IDCODE compare → JTAG boundary-scan → JTAG ATPG → BIST → switch to SWD → SWD IDCODE verify → flash program + functional verify.
ADIv5 SWD enables in-system functional verification during production test.
data_formats_supported_by_adiv5: CoreSight ROM Table — published at MEM-AP.BASE.
CoreSight Trace formats — ITM / DWT / ETM packets.
CMSIS-DAP protocol — Arm's open USB-side debug-probe protocol.
OpenOCD / pyOCD / probe-rs — open-source host-side libraries.

in_band_test_facilities.name: DAP register access
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Memory-mapped read/write of any component register over the Debug APB for bring-up/debug.

in_band_test_facilities.name: ROM-Table discovery
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Enumerate and verify the presence/identity of every debug/trace component (CIDR/PIDR/DEVARCH/DEVTYPE).

in_band_test_facilities.name: Trace capture (ETM/ITM/STM -> sink)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Observe internal program flow and software instrumentation in real time.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Cross-trigger (CTI/CTM)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Coordinate halt/restart/triggers across components for test.

in_band_test_facilities.name: TPIU/ETB/ETF/ETR sinks
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Off-chip or on-chip trace capture for post-mortem analysis.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Component identification and presence (ROM Table + ID registers).
DP CTRL/STAT status / sticky error flags.
Per-source ATB trace IDs and trace content at the sink.
Cross-trigger channel state via the CTIs.
